scope: Installation, testing and acceptance of 28 explicitly selected DB2 precast reinforced-concrete rainwater-inlet assemblies with ductile-iron D400 gratings and DN 200 outlets. Bodies, gratings, frames, outlet connectors, seals, silt baskets, bedding, mortar, earthworks, labor, mechanisms, QA and logistics are direct project inputs.
sourceAuthority: Approved stormwater design organization, precast-inlet and grating manufacturers, geotechnical engineer, construction laboratory and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved inlet layout, elevations and connection schedule
approved inlet-body, grating, frame, load-class and outlet specification
approved connector, seal and silt-basket schedule
approved excavation, bedding, mortar, backfill and excess-soil quantities
installation method with labor and mechanism quantities
conditional dewatering, excavation-shoring and pavement-restoration schedules
supplier body-package quantity and approved retained spare-body quantity
forbiddenClaims: stormwater pipe, manhole, silt-trap or full outlet scope inherited from a network template
earthwork, material, labor or mechanism quantities derived from route-length coefficients
automatic inlet spacing or quantity from route length
automatic dewatering, shoring or pavement restoration
universal spare-body or supplier package quantity
